Imposta Strict-Transport-Security con ma: Set Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least 31536000 (one year), and includeSubDomains if every subdomain uses HTTPS: the browser will no longer use HTTP for this site.
Definisci una Content-Security-Policy ch: Define a Content-Security-Policy listing the only origins from which scripts and resources may load: it is the main defence against XSS and content injection.
Imposta X-Frame-Options: DENY (o SAMEORI: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN), or the frame-ancestors directive in the CSP, so that other sites cannot embed your pages (clickjacking).
Imposta X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff,: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, so that the browser does not "guess" file types and does not run as a script something that is not one.
Imposta Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-w: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter) so that full URLs with sensitive parameters are not sent to other sites.
Imposta Permissions-Policy per disattiva: Set a Permissions-Policy to switch off the browser features the site does not use (camera, microphone, geolocation…).
Facoltativo: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy:: Optional: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin isolates the window from those opened by other sites.
Facoltativo: Cross-Origin-Resource-Polic: Optional: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin or same-site restricts who can load your resources.
Facoltativo: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Polic: Optional: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp is needed only if the site requires cross-origin isolation (for example for SharedArrayBuffer).
Valuta solo gli header HTTP e i cookie (: It assesses only the HTTP headers and cookies (Set-Cookie) of a single GET response for the given page.
Non verifica autenticazione, API, permes: It does not check authentication, APIs, permissions, file uploads or the application's logic.
Gli header Cross-Origin (COOP, CORP, COE: The Cross-Origin headers (COOP, CORP, COEP) are optional: useful to isolate the site, not always necessary on a public site.
Il punteggio non sostituisce un penetrat: The score does not replace a penetration test or an architecture review.
SameSite=None: il cookie viene inviato a: SameSite=None: the cookie is also sent with requests from other sites (and requires Secure).
SameSite non impostato: il comportamento: SameSite not set: the behaviour depends on the browser.
Script e stili scritti dentro la pagina: Scripts and styles written inside the page are allowed: an XSS attack can inject its own, and the CSP protects much less.
eval() e funzioni simili trasformano tes: eval() and similar functions turn text into executable code: they increase the chances of XSS.
script-src o default-src accettano scrip: script-src or default-src accept scripts from any site: the policy restricts nothing.
La CSP accetta data: in script-src: The CSP accepts data: in script-src
Permette di eseguire script scritti dire: It allows scripts written directly in a data: URL to run.
La policy segnala le violazioni ma non l: The policy reports violations but does not block them yet.
L’header Server può rivelare prodotto e: The Server header may reveal the software product and version.
Rivela la tecnologia usata dal sito (lin: It reveals the technology used by the site (language or framework).
It identifies a component of the site.

La pagina arriva in chiaro su HTTP: chi: The page is delivered in clear text over HTTP: whoever controls the network (for example a public Wi-Fi) can read and modify the traffic.
Attiva HTTPS con un certificato valido e: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
Un cookie di sessione deve avere Secure,: A session cookie must have Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax or Strict.
Valuta Secure e SameSite anche per i coo: Consider Secure and SameSite for cookies unrelated to the session too.
Restringi script-src e default-src alle: Restrict script-src and default-src to the necessary origins and avoid unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval and the wildcard.
Togli o generalizza questi header: non s: Remove or generalise these headers: visitors do not need them and they help anyone looking for vulnerable versions.
Nessuna lacuna importante nei controlli: No significant gaps in the checks performed.
Lettura passiva degli header HTTP, dei c: Passive reading of a response's HTTP headers, cookies and Content-Security-Policy. It does not try any attacks and does not replace a test of authentication, APIs or application logic.
